subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

He ordered the police to pursue the robber and his gang.

options.text: Order the police to pursue the robber gang.
Pursue the robber and gang were the orders by police.
The robber and gang were pursued.
The police were ordered to pursue the robber and his gang.

solution:
The solution is **The police were ordered to pursue the robber and his gang**.
